banner.title: Cookies & analytics
banner.body: TeslaSync uses strictly necessary storage to keep you signed in and to remember your preferences. With your consent, we also collect anonymous performance and error reports to improve the app. You can change your mind any time in Settings → Privacy.

essential.title: Strictly necessary
essential.body: Authentication, session, theme, and saved drafts. Required for the app to work and exempt from consent under the ePrivacy directive.

analytics.title: Performance & error reporting
analytics.body: Anonymous Core Web Vitals (page-load timings) and uncaught error reports sent to this TeslaSync instance to help operators diagnose issues. No third parties involved.

section.title: Cookies & analytics consent
section.bodyOn: This deployment collects anonymous performance and error reports with your consent. Strictly necessary storage (auth, settings) is always on.
section.bodyOff: This deployment does not require consent collection — these controls let you preview the user-facing flow.

state.declined: Declined — only essential storage in use
state.unknown: Not decided — banner will appear on next visit
